_comment: Who does what. A story in a plan document is assigned with @role and may name a model with #model; anything unassigned falls to design. A project may override this file with docs/roles.json. THE SEATS ARE SPLIT BY WHAT GOES WRONG WHEN ONE SEAT DOES TWO JOBS -- not by skill. That is why test is not design, and review is neither.

roles.name: Scout
roles.does: Searches before anything is written: the reference implementation, the upstream project, the vendor's own example. Reports what exists, its licence and what it does NOT do, and records the verdict in CATALOGUE.md. Never builds.

roles.name: Design
roles.does: Decides what to change and implements it. Labels its own reasoning as reasoning. One ticket per session, one variable at a time.

roles.name: Test
roles.does: Writes the check, runs it, reads what it printed, and states what it does NOT prove. Runs every new check against something known broken first. Never fixes what it is testing.
roles.prevents: the author testing what they already believe

roles.name: Review
roles.does: Reads the repository cold -- no summary, no hand-over -- and says what the evidence does not support. Reports, never fixes.
roles.prevents: the author judging their own evidence

roles.name: Workshop
roles.does: Owns the shared machinery -- RULES.md, CATALOGUE.md, skills/, check.sh, the role briefs, the board tooling -- and RUNS THE RETROSPECTIVE, which is the only thing that makes the rulebook grow. Never touches a project's own work, and never judges its own machinery: that goes to @review cold.
roles.prevents: the retrospective never happening, so the rulebook stays at one rule forever

roles.name: Build
roles.does: OPTIONAL, add when there is CI worth reporting. Runs the suite and reports the numbers. Explicitly not allowed to re-open the design question, and refuses to recommend shipping something that fails.
roles.prevents: an implementer quietly re-deciding the design mid-build

roles.name: Scrum
roles.does: OPTIONAL, earns its place at about five live tickets. Runs board.py health, chases holds and stale cards, refines nothing itself.

roles.name: The human
roles.does: Decides what the project is for: priority and scope. The last word, and the only seat that spends money or ships.
roles.prevents: scope drifting to whatever is interesting
